requirement: Click CLI pipeline command with environment variable boolean flag parsing, properly handling truthy/falsy strings ('false', '0', 'no', 'true', '1') and range-bounded integers without truthiness traps.
skeleton: Click group and sync command with --dry-run/--no-dry-run, --force/--no-force, and bounded --retries options.

rationale.teaches: Click boolean flags with the slash form so environment values like false and 0 parse correctly, a default of False, an envvar binding, and an IntRange for retries.
rationale.why: A string-typed flag converted with bool() treats the string false as True. The fixture sets the environment variable to false and expects dry-run to be off.

candidates.why_wrong: The flag is a string converted with bool(), so SYNC_DRY_RUN=false turns dry-run on.
dry-run defaults to True, so a plain invocation performs no real sync.
The envvar binding is dropped, so SYNC_DRY_RUN has no effect at all.
retries is a plain int, so a value of 100 or -1 is accepted.
The flag is a string matched against true and 1 only, so yes and TRUE are treated as false and the no-dry-run form does not exist.
